purpose: Choose and combine the current locally validated candidate routes without leaderboard tuning
valid_aobt_gate: Own released AOBT proxy finite and within 0..7200 seconds

The predeclared v9b movement-only expert blend from v7 on valid-AOBT rows, using v9b's fixed seasonally selected weight
valid_aobt_selection: Among alternatives passing their already published Jan/Jul, unchanged Nov/Dec and Apr/Oct gates, choose the smallest all-finite January/July RMSE on the exact common 2025 OOF universe. Ties favor unchanged v7, then v8 combo, then v9b. Freeze that choice before the February/August reserved guard.
valid_aobt_reserved_guard: The chosen replacement must pass reports/reserved_guard_protocol.json with its fixed formula. If it fails, retain v7 on valid-AOBT rows; do not tune the formula or select an alternative using guard outcomes.
excluded_valid_route: The older standalone v8 policy based on v6 is not a portfolio alternative. The fixed v7 combo has its own required gates.

missing_clock_alternative: Use the movement-only expert at its already selected Jan/Jul weight only if its original two folds, April/October paired audit and February/August reserved guard all pass. Otherwise retain v7 on that gate.
combination: The valid-AOBT and missing-clock masks are disjoint. Apply each selected correction once to v7. All rows outside both gates must equal v7 exactly. No further weight selection or airport exceptions.
combined_oof_gate: Before any ranking assembly, require exact common unique 2025 OOF IDs, targets, months, timestamps and gates; verify v5 and v7 reference predictions agree exactly on the missing-clock gate. Require combined all-finite RMSE improvement and positive paired UTC-day 95% gain lower bound separately on Jan/Jul and Nov/Dec. A failed composition is rejected without retuning.
ranking_gate: Only selected and fully guarded component models may generate ranking predictions. Exact template ID/order, two-column schema, finite nonnegative predictions, model/input/validation hashes, and unchanged predictions outside the gates are mandatory.
publication: Publish the final source, selected policy, aggregate validation and file manifest before CLI upload; fresh quota checks enforce official naming, five submissions/day and 1 GB bucket limits.
leaderboard_use: Ranking scores are recorded only after policy and file freezing. They never choose these models, weights, routes or checks.
limitations: Repeated 2025 OOF comparisons and inherited legacy base limitations remain. Reserved checks verify fixed component changes rather than independently estimating the whole ensemble.
